# 30A Junk Removal

> 30A Junk Removal LLC is a Florida-based junk removal company serving the 30A corridor, Panama City Beach, and Walton & Bay Counties — specializing in vacation rental turnovers, estate cleanouts, hot tub removal, renovation debris, and same-day junk hauling. 4.9★ rated on 127+ reviews, licensed and insured, locally owned, operating since 2018.

## About

30A Junk Removal LLC provides professional junk removal services along Florida's Scenic Highway 30A and the broader Emerald Coast. We serve homeowners, vacation rental property managers, contractors, real estate professionals, and commercial properties from Inlet Beach to Panama City Beach. The company is licensed, insured, and based at 307 Sand Oak Blvd, Panama City Beach, FL 32413. Operating hours are 7 days a week, 7am–6pm. We have completed over 2,400 jobs since 2018 with a 4.9 star average rating on 127+ verified reviews.

## Pricing Quick Reference

- Minimum service: $150 (single small item or quarter-truck)
- Quarter-truck load: $150-$250 (single couch, dresser, grill, or small appliance)
- Half-truck load: $250-$400 (bedroom set or single-room cleanout)
- Three-quarter truck load: $400-$550 (multi-room or larger cleanout)
- Full truck load: $550-$650 (whole-property or large debris job)
- Hot tub removal: $300-$850 depending on size, access, deck removal
- Estate cleanout: $1,500-$8,000+ depending on property size and scope
- Construction debris: $350-$1,500 per service-load
- Refrigerator: $175-$300 single, $100-$150 bundled (includes EPA 608)
- Mattress removal: $150-$200 single (includes Florida bedbug bag)
